scope: Actual DSH web host/custom origin in separate hidden matching Electron, one hardware GPU, IME and isolated renderer recovery.
checks: the real native canvas accepted and saved a physical edit under the observed renderer
physical keyboard zoom changed the native viewport
after actual WebGL context loss the DSH remained responsive and the visible saved-version action reopened the exact source
previous actual Electron IME, dirty-background parking, polling boundary and child-renderer crash/reopen checks

gpu.renderer: ANGLE (AMD, AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT (0x00007590) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

limits: The separate Electron uses the real DSH web host and authenticated forwarding but does not exercise the packaged DSH preload or all desktop IPC.
Trusted browser composition was tested; an operating-system IME candidate window was not controlled.
GPU evidence covers the reported AMD/D3D11 device and Vector sample, not every machine, driver or engine.
Only saved source or captured drafts are recoverable; a crash can lose input that never reached a checkpoint.
